articles.title: U.S. President Trump names CFTC, SEC nominees for first time in a year
articles.snippet: U.S. President Donald Trump has named two potential commissioners each to the Securities and Exchange Commission and Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

articles.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
articles.snippet: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.
